entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Phew! That was delicious.
What did I just witness?
You sure packed it away.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'm always like this after a meet.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: In all honesty, I'd like to keep going...[n]but any more will end up harming my[n]performance.
So the meet's done?
Was it worth it?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Simply put? It was a disaster.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I've been feeling like I'm getting back[n]into the natural flow of things, thanks[n]to you, [lName]-senpai...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: But when the moment of truth arrived,[n]my body still wouldn't move the way[n]that I wanted it to...
That sounds rough.
Is it more of a mental thing?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Yes, I've really hit a wall with this.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I think... that's a big factor.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: The cause is a bit different, but I also had[n]trouble performing when I hit my growth[n]spurt back in middle school.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Back then, I was able to keep pushing[n]myself because my sister was by my side...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Something similar happened to me in[n]middle school—but back then, I had[n]someone by my side that kept me going...
Really?
Who do you mean?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I... have a younger sister.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: We promised each other that we'd win[n]international gymnastics competitions[n]together...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: But this spring, she... died,[n]in an accident.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I promised her we'd take the gold for[n]our routines across the world...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: But I can't stop worrying about my[n]lack of improvement lately.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I've really been throwing myself into[n]practice, but I wonder if even that[n]won't be enough...
You really are doing your best.
It's not over yet.
Is this really your limit?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: [lName]-senpai...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Thank you for being so thoughtful.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: [lName]-senpai...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: You're right—it's just getting started!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: [lName]-senpai...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: No. And you're right—I can't let it end[n]like this!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: You just keep on rescuing me, don't you?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Okay! No more brooding!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: There are still more meets left this year.[n]I'm going to start from scratch and train[n]as hard as I can.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Thank you so much for listening to[n]all that!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Now I feel like I've been recharged,[n]mind, body, and spirit—

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: ...Well, at least my mind and spirit[n]are recharged!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: The best way to stave off hunger is with[n]some vigorous activity! I'm going to jog[n]home—take care!
